text: This is the worst managed company I've ever encountered. I called to ask what time they would be coming, and they said in two hours. It's been 4-5 days now, and they haven't shown up. Terrible service.

I've often called to have it delivered to my workplace, and the service charge has never been more than 800 baht. This time, I had it delivered to my home. I saw a foreigner there, so I asked him to charge me 6,500 baht, claiming it was a big problem, even though the previous time the truck had been delivered, it had never cost more than 1,500 baht.
I had the septic tank emptied for 15 full days, and it cost 2000 baht.
author_name: ศักดิ์สิทธิ์ ศรชนะ
